name: career-coach
description: Produces a skill-gap analysis and a phased learning roadmap for a candidate targeting a specific role (using hybrid search on the career_paths and skills_taxonomy collections), AND retrieves compensation benchmarks — base/total/percentiles, benefits norms, and grounded negotiation ranges — for a role at a given seniority and location (using hybrid search on the compensation_data collection). Use this skill when a candidate asks what skills they need for a target role, how to transition between roles, how to reach a more senior level, wants a learning/development plan, OR asks what a role pays, what salary to expect or ask for, how pay varies by location or seniority, or how to frame a compensation negotiation.
